change_summary: PLOS ONE retracted this paper over concerns about peer review integrity and possible manipulation of the publication process. The editors say these concerns call into question the validity and provenance of the reported results. The author did not respond or could not be reached. The notice is about the whole paper, not one part.
evaluation: Your draft cites the Dutta paper in Section 3 as the main evidence for choosing an LSTM, and in Section 4 as the source of the model settings you start from without tuning. The paper has been retracted as a whole because of concerns about peer review integrity, and the editors say these concerns call the validity and provenance of the results into question. Both uses are touched, so the impact on your draft is high.
recommendation: Dutta [14] is retracted because of concerns about peer review integrity, and the editors say these concerns call into question the validity and provenance of the reported results. Replace it as the main evidence in Section 3, and raise with co-authors or your supervisor that the Section 4 starting settings come from it.
